s: October 30, 2020 - For repeat buyers, your current home no longer meets your needs: You’re ready for more space, a new neighborhood or to downsize. ✅ Savings: You'll need money for a down payment and closing costs, as well as for moving costs and other expenses. ✅ Low debt: Your debt-to-income ratio (DTI) shows how much of your monthly income goes toward paying debt (like student loans, car payments or credit cards).
